blind.description: A stylized fantasy/medieval wooden scriptorium desk with an integrated low bench. Features a sloped drafting surface holding an open illuminated book with inscribed text and a resting quill pen. A raised back shelf holds an upright closed red volume and a small green inkpot. The desk frame has paneled wooden sides, square corner posts, and an extending base runner that connects to a low four-legged wooden stool with a slatted seat. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and clean with stylized hand-painted wood grain textures.
blind.from_above: Seen from overhead, it forms a compact rectangular footprint with the main desk on the left and a three-plank slatted stool extending to the right. Clearly visible are the circular green inkwell rim, upright book spine, the two open beige pages with red script, a diagonal quill, and the square posts framing the structure.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall at the top backboard (around chest height on the 5 ft 9 in figure); approximately 2.5 feet wide and 3.5 feet long including the stool.
